focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: From Events to Evidence: A Practical Primer on Discrete Probability
utility_use_case: A researcher receives a CSV export of paired sensor readings and needs a quick, reproducible check for trends, unusual ranges, and incomplete records before formal analysis. The CSV Visualizer creates a labeled scatter plot or histogram and prints the number of finite observations retained and rows omitted. Saving the image and its command with the analysis notes makes this exploratory step auditable. The resulting visualization is descriptive only: it does not test hypotheses, estimate uncertainty, or establish causality.
